from itertools import product
def find_assignments(d,name):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {d} input'],G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h=len(go); W=len(go[0])
    dc=max((c for c in range(len(gi[0])) if len({gi[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and gi[0][c]!=0), default=-1)
    # all non-divider components (color != 4) that have cells left of divider... include everything except full dividers
    comps=components(gi)
    compids=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1 and gi[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]!=4]
    if not compids:
        return [None],-1
    outset={(r,c):go[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(W)}
    def dom_run(cells,colored=None):
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
        hb=max(rs)-min(rs); wb=max(cs)-min(cs)
        dom='h' if wb>=hb else 'v'
        rng=range(W) if dom=='h' else range(h)
        Ls=range(max(2,hb+1)) if dom=='h' else range(max(2,hb+1))
        cand=[]
        start=min(rs) if dom=='h' else min(cs)
        for L in Ls:
            for s in rng:
                bar={(s,i) if dom=='h' else (i,s) for i in range(L)}
                if not(bar&outset or not set(outset)&bar):
                    cand.append(bar)
        return cand,dom
    res=[]
    for comp in compids:
        col=gi[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]; cells=sorted(comp)
        cand,dom=dom_run(cells,col)
        res.append(((col,cells),cand,dom))
    # assign each component a disjoint bar from its candidate list, covering exactly outset
    good=[]
    def recurse(i,used,out_covered):
        if i==len(res):
            if used==outset: good.append([c[i] for c in res])  # placeholder
            return
        col,cells,d=r[i]; cand,rdom=d
        for bar in cand:
            newused=used|bar
            if newused==outset:
                recurse(i+1,newused,out_covered)
            elif newused<=outset and all(v in {k:v for k,v in outset.items()}__ne__: False for _ in [] ):
                pass
        # use set subset check directly
    # simpler brute force with early pruning
    import sys
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10**6)
    assignments=[]
    def rec(idx,used,cover_map):
        if idx==len(res):
            if used==outset: assignments.append((tuple(cover_map[k] for k in range(len(res))),))
            return
        col,cells,dom=candidates[idx][0]; bars=candidates[idx][1]
        for bar in bars:
            if bar&used: continue
            rec(idx+1,used|bar,cover_map.copy())
    candidates=list(zip(range(len(compids)),res))
    # map each component index to its cand lists
    byidx=[r[i][1] for i,r in enumerate(zip(compids,res))]
    rec(0,set())
    print(name,'assignments:',len(assignments))
    return assignments
for d in [1,2,3]:
    print('demo',d,find_assignments(d,d))

def analyze(d):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {d} input'],G[f'Demo pair {d} output']
    h=len(go); W=len(go[0])
    outcells={(r,c):go[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(W)}
    comps=[c for c in components(gi) if gi[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]!=4]
    for comp in comps:
        col=gi[comp[0][0]][comp[0][1]]
        rs=[r for r,_ in comp]; cs=[c for _,c in comp]
        hb=max(rs)-min(rs); wb=max(cs)-min(cs)
        print(d,col,len(comp),'bbox',(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)),('h' if wb>=hb else 'v'))
analyze(1);analyze(2);analyze(3)

def bar_of(gi):
    bs=[b for b in comps8(gi) if b['col']!=4]
    bars=[]
    for sb in bs:
        pts=set(sb['pts']); rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        t_,rt,l,c_=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        vh = (rt-t_)==(c_-l)==2 and len(pts)==4 and (l,t_) in pts and (c_,rt) in pts and (t_,c_) in pts
        # determine: bracket vertical iff cells at all four corners of bbox
        verts={(t_,l),(t_,c_),(rt,l),(rt,c_)}
        vh=bool(verts<=pts and len(verts)==4)
        if vh:
            # vertical bar from bracket: two arms -> length 2, single column = l
            bars.append(dict(col=sb['col'],cells=[(t_+k,l+k) for k in (0,2)],vert=True))
        else:
            L=(c_-l)+1; R=[(t_+k,l+k) for k in range(L)]
            bars.append(dict(col=sb['col'],cells=R,vert=False))
    return bars

def run_len(cells):
    from collections import defaultdict
    H=defaultdict(list);V=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in cells: H[r].append(c); V[c].append(r)
    def maxlen(seq): return max((len(s) for s in seq),default=0)
    h=max(len(v) for v in H.values())
    v=max(len(x) for x in V.values())
    w=max((c-max(cs)+1 for cs in H.values()),default=0)
    bh=max(rs-min(rs)+1 for rs in set()) 
    # bounding box dims:
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells];cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    bh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; bw=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    return h,v,bh,bw

steps.input:
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    ib=comps_nz(G[nm+' input']); ob=comps_nz(G[nm+' output'])
    print('==',nm)
    for m in sorted(ib,key=lambda x:(-max(p[1] for p in x['pts']),min(p[0] for p in x['pts'])))[:12]:
        rs=[p[0] for p in m['pts']];cs=[p[1] for p in m['pts']]
        H=defaultdict(list);V=defaultdict(list)
        for r,c in m['pts']:H[r].append(c);V[c].append(r)
        hr=max((len(set(v)) for v in H.values()),default=0)
        vr=max((len(set(h)) for h in V.values()),default=0)
        # horizontal runs: consecutive cols per row
        def conseq(seq):
            if not seq:return 0
            s=1
            for a,b in zip(seq,seq[1:]):
                s+=b-a if b-a==1 else 0
            return s
        hruns=[conseq(H[r]) for r in H]; vruns=[conseq(V[c]) for c in V]
        hr_=max(hruns,default=1)
        vr_=max(vruns,default=1)
        for o in ob:
            if o['col']==m['col']: break
        o_=[o for o in ob if o['col']==m['col']]
        os_=[o for o in ob if o['col']==m['col']]
        outl=[o for o in ob if o['col']==m['col']][0] if [o for o in ob if o['col']==m['col']] else None
        rsO=[p[0] for p in outl['pts']];csO=[p[1] for p in outl['pts']]
        print(f"col={m['col']} size_in={len(m['pts'])} hrun={hr_} verrun={vr_} -> out {max(rsO)-min(rsO)+1}x{max(csO)-min(csO)+1}")

    H_=max(r for r,_ in cells)+1;W_=max(c for _,c in cells)+1
    res=[]

        ol.append(row)
    return ol

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i,o=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0]); div=max(range(W),key=lambda j:(W-j)*sum(i[r][j]==4 for r in range(H)))
    # count colors
    cnt={}
    for col,cells in comps_color(i):
        cnt.setdefault(col,0); cnt[col]+=len(cells)
    print('===',k,'color counts',cnt)
    # per-color bbox info
    for col,cells in comps_color(i):
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
        hr=defaultdict(list); hc=defaultdict(list)
        for r,c in cells: hr[r].append(c); hc[c].append(r)
        hlr=max((len(g) for g in hr.values()),default=0)
        hvc=max((len(g) for g in hc.values()),default=0)
        dom='h' if hlr>=hvc else 'v'
        ob=[(r,c) for r in range(len(o)) for c in range(len(o[0])) if o[r][c]==col]
        outr=min(r for r,_ in ob) if ob else None
        ouh=(max(r for r,_ in ob)-min(r for r,_ in ob)+1) if ob else 0
        ouw=(max(c for _,c in ob)-min(c for _,c in ob)+1) if ob else 0
        print(col,len(cells),'dom',dom,'bbox',(min(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs)),'->out rows',ouh,'cols',ouw,'rows',[r for r,_ in ob])
